title: The Whiskey Barrel Hideaway: Jam Out & Race Bulls
description:
Turn up your Nashville getaway at this whiskey-inspired retreat! Jam in your private music room, craft drinks at the bar, and relax on the rooftop with skyline views. Perfect for groups and music lovers, this spacious home features a chef’s kitchen, luxe baths, and a fun bunk room. Steps from live music, nightlife, and top attractions—your Music City adventure starts here!

The space
Welcome to The Whiskey Lounge, where Nashville’s rhythm meets laid-back luxury. This one-of-a-kind retreat is crafted for connection—friends strumming guitars in the jam room, families sharing laughs around the whiskey bar, and late-night stories on the rooftop under string lights and skyline views.

Inside, the open-concept living space feels vibrant and warm, blending rustic whiskey-bar charm with modern finishes. The chef’s kitchen is stocked and ready for your next meal or cocktail hour, while every bedroom offers plush comfort and privacy for your crew to unwind after nights out on Broadway.

🎸 Entertainment Highlights

- Jam room with real acoustic + electric guitars & amp
- Private whiskey bar for your own tastings
- TVs in every room and plenty of games for downtime
- Rooftop lounge with dining, outdoor TV & skyline views

🍳 Chef’s Kitchen
Fully equipped for family meals or entertaining friends—with both indoor and rooftop dining spaces.

🛁 Relax & Recharge
Spacious, stylish bathrooms with modern touches designed for comfort and ease.

🏡 Bedrooms:
- King Suite: A private sanctuary with a king bed and ample space to unwind.
- Queen Room 1 & 2: Each features a plush queen bed for restful nights.
- Bunk Room: The ultimate group space with six single beds—ideal for kids and friends.
- Upstairs Loft: Two fold-down futons offer extra sleeping options.

Guest access
When you arrive, you’ll have easy and flexible access to the home. Park in the two dedicated spots labeled 3226 and enter through the back door, or if you’re using a rideshare service, access via the front door on Charlotte Ave. You’ll receive a personalized door code for keyless entry, making check-in a breeze. Whether you’re heading out to explore or coming back to relax, access is quick, convenient, and secure.

Other things to note
Bring your furry friends along! We’re a pet-friendly retreat, and we welcome up to two pets for a fee of $100 per pet. With plenty of nearby parks and walkable areas, your four-legged companions will love exploring Nashville as much as you do! Please let us know in advance if you’re bringing pets so we can prepare accordingly.

We require both a waiver and ID upload prior to receiving check-in instructions. You are welcome to view the waiver terms prior to booking! 

Any cancellation refund issued will be less the cost of payment processing fees incurred (these are typically 4%, but vary by booking platform). Because payment processing fees are incurred at the time the reservation is made and are not refunded by the payment processor, we must subtract this amount from any refund that we issue.

There is a $500 fine for not replacing the TV cover when not in use.
